sigmoid — 2D gray op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "sigmoid", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: scale_image_max (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

S-curve contrast enhancement using a logistic (sigmoid) function. Mapped to HALCON's `scale_image_max (Maximum gray value spreading in the value range 0 to 255.), but the processing differs from scale_image_max`, which stretches the dynamic range to its maximum (this is closer to a different operation than an approximation).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が S字の傾き k = 4 + 12a（4〜16）を、b が中心（変曲点）の位置 x0 = 0.2 + 0.6b（0.2〜0.8）を振る（1/(1+exp(-k*(v-x0)))）。x0` 付近の階調差を強調し、両端の階調差は圧縮する。
